name: Ace Attorney: Dual Destinies VR
summary:
◆ Immersive Courtroom Experience: Step into the courtroom in VR and interact with suspicious witnesses and questionable evidence to prove your client’s innocence. Deliver your OBJECTION! face-to-face like never before!

◆ Shout It, Point It: Fully playable with controllers—or dial up the immersion with voice-activated "OBJECTION!" and hand-tracked gestures, calling out witnesses and presenting evidence with your own hands.
